newsitem.title: POLAND: SWARZEDZ EXTENDS SURGE ON DM 200 MLN DEAL.
newsitem.headline: SWARZEDZ EXTENDS SURGE ON DM 200 MLN DEAL.

text.p: Polish furniture producer Swarzedz SA rose 9.2 percent to 10.1 zlotys, surging for the third straight session on Wednesday's news that it had signed a 200-million-mark deal, traders said.
Swarzedz's turnover amounted to 1.6 million zlotys.
"The contract is really big and the expected margin of 12 percent is also high, so no wonder it keeps rising," one trader said, adding the stock could extend its gains to 11 zlotys.
Under the deal Swarzedz will produce furniture worth 200 million marks until 2002 for Germany's International Moebelhandelskantor Gmbh & Co KH (IMK), part of Schieder Group.
